request: Read back once-only in-Gate UDS handoff acceptance status and publish result only if completed; no model restart, no repeat probe, no private secret output.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
x=/run/ai-core/uds-handoff-14fed8
state=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate cat "$x.status")
printf 'AI_CORE_UDS_HANDOFF_PROCESS_STATE=%s\n' "$state"
if test "$state" = DONE; then
 rc=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate cat "$x.exit")
 result=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate cat "$x.result")
 body="AI_CORE_UDS_HANDOFF_PRIVATE_RESULT SOURCE=14fed8d3ecb96a78b25cd9579940dc74793f7bfc EXIT=$rc $result"
 gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
 printf 'AI_CORE_UDS_HANDOFF_RESULT_PUBLISHED=YES EXIT=%s\n' "$rc"
else
 docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]};r=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184/internal/handoff/status",headers=h);v=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=9));print("RESIDENT="+str(len(v["resident"]))+" ACTIVE="+str(sum(v["active"].values()))+" HANDOFF="+str(bool(v["handoff"]))+" RECOVERY="+str(len(v["recovery_pending"])))'
fi
